Sir,

Further to Misc. 119/40, dated 25-4-40.

I beg to report, that the "Centro Social Recreativo"
Club situated at No. 115 Medhurst Road, was formally
opened on the 1-5-40. On invitation from the President
of the club, Mr. Mario A. Ferras (Portuguese), the under-
signed accompanied by Inspt. Lees and D.C.I. Black attend-
ed at 7.45 p.m. and left the premises at 8.45 p.m.
During the visit referred to, it was observed that only
some twelve members were present on the premises, all
being Portuguese citizens, no ceremony took place to
mark the opening of the club.

During the course of conversation with Mr. M. A.
Ferras, it was learned that the club had at present some
two hundred members, all being Portuguese citizens.
Vide remarks of the Commissioner of Police as appended to
the attached report reading "We had better put in some
members". In order to test the attitude of the committee
of the club in relation to the enrolment of members of
other nationalities, it was suggested to Mr. Ferras that
as the club was in the Chengtu Road District, same would
serve as a convenient recreation centre for two or three
members of the Foreign staff attached to this station,
who had expressed a desire to be enrolled as was to be
expected, Mr. Ferras did not appear to be enthused with the
suggestion, but promised that he would bring the matter
before the Standing Committee of the club, at their meet-
ing on the 6-5-40, and would notify the undersigned as to
the committee's decision.

钧座，

继1940年4月25日杂项档案119/40之后。

卑职谨此报告，位于麦特赫斯脱路115号的“Centro Social Recreativo”俱乐部已于1940年5月1日正式开幕。应俱乐部主席马里奥·A·费拉斯先生（Mr. Mario A. Ferras，葡萄牙籍）之邀请，卑职由利斯巡官（Inspt. Lees）和布莱克副督察（D.C.I. Black）陪同，于下午7时45分抵达，并于下午8时45分离开该处。在上述访问期间，观察到现场仅有约十二名会员在场，均为葡萄牙公民，未举行任何仪式以标志俱乐部的开幕。

在与M. A. 费拉斯先生的谈话过程中，获悉该俱乐部目前约有二百名会员，均为葡萄牙公民。参阅附呈报告中警务处处长所加批注：“我们最好安插一些会员进去”。为了试探俱乐部委员会对于招收其他国籍会员的态度，卑职向费拉斯先生建议，鉴于该俱乐部位于成都路捕房辖区，可作为本捕房两名或三名外籍职员方便的休闲中心，这些职员已表示希望入会，这是意料之中的事。费拉斯先生似乎对该建议并不热衷，但承诺他将在1940年5月6日的俱乐部常务委员会会议上提出此事，并将委员会的决定通知卑职。

Sir,

Further to Misc. 119/40 dated 17-3-40.

On the 24-4-40, the undersigned by appointment interviewed Mr. Mario A. Ferras, in reference to matters pertaining to the above, when the following was ascertained:-

The name of the club will be known as the "Centro Social Recreativo" and is registered with the Portuguese Consular Authorities. The membership of the club is open to all nationalities. Membership will be divided into two grades i.e. Full members and Ordinary members. Applicants for membership have to be proposed by a Portuguese member and seconded by another. Membership fee is as follows:-

Annual subscription of $24.00 for a Full member and $12.00 for an Ordinary member.

The President of club is Mr. Mario A. Ferras, Portuguese citizen, c/o Shanghai Water Works Co., Ltd., No. 484 Kiangse Road. The standing committee and trustees of the club are:- Mr. Mario A. Ferras, Mr. Jose H. Gutterres, Mr. Francis P. Gutterres and one other (not yet appointed).

Questioned regarding the difference between the two grades of members, Mr. Ferras stated that "Full members" were entitled to full privileges afforded them by the club whilst "Ordinary members" were more restricted, and would not be permitted to indulge in card games, the use of the card rooms being exclusively for "Full Members" only, no guests being allowed in the latter rooms.

继1940年3月17日杂项档案119/40之后。

1940年4月24日，卑职按约定就上述事项采访了马里奥·A·费拉斯先生，当时查明情况如下：

该俱乐部名称定为“Centro Social Recreativo”，并在葡萄牙领事当局注册。俱乐部会员资格向所有国籍开放。会员分为两级，即正式会员和普通会员。入会申请人须由一名葡萄牙会员提名，并由另一名会员附议。会费如下：

正式会员年费为24.00元，普通会员年费为12.00元。

俱乐部主席为马里奥·A·费拉斯先生，葡萄牙公民，通讯地址为江西路484号上海自来水公司。俱乐部常务委员会成员及受托人为：马里奥·A·费拉斯先生、何塞·H·古特雷斯先生（Mr. Jose H. Gutterres）、弗朗西斯·P·古特雷斯先生（Mr. Francis P. Gutterres）以及另一人（尚未任命）。

当被问及两级会员之间的区别时，费拉斯先生称，“正式会员”享有俱乐部提供的所有特权，而“普通会员”则受到较多限制，不允许参与牌类游戏，棋牌室仅供“正式会员”专用，且后者房间内不允许携带客人。

ARTICLES OF THE "CENTRO SOCIAL RECREATIVO"

1. The Centro Social Recreativo, with its Club Rooms at 115 Medhurst Road, Shanghai, shall function under the following Articles.
2. The Center shall be called the "Centro Social Recreative" and it shall be registered at the Portuguese Consulate General at Shanghai.
3. The Center shall be a Proprietary Club, the names of the Proprietors being registered as such at the Portuguese Consulate General at Shanghai.
4. The Centro Social Recreativo is instituted to provide a central and convenient Club in Shanghai for members of the Portuguese and all other communities, and to do all such things as in the opinion of the Proprietors shall tend to promote Portuguese relations with other nationalities.
5. The objects for which the Center is formed are:- To sponsor recreation and entertainment by means of social gatherings, dances, concerts, card games, lectures, books and periodicals.
6. The Center shall be under the management and direction of a Board composed of five (5) Trustees appointed by the Proprietors of the Center.
7. This Board shall include a President, an Honorary Secretary, an Honorary Treasurer, an Assistant Honorary Secretary and an Assistant Honorary Treasurer, all of whom shall be Portuguese Citizens and duly registered at the Portuguese Consulate General as such Citizens.
8. The Trustees shall remain in office till death or resignation, or until the Proprietors shall think proper to remove any one or more of them. The appointment of a new Trustee shall be by the Proprietors. All securities shall be taken, stocks purchased, and purchases and investments made by the Trustees in the name of the Centre Social Recreativo; the property, the subject-matter of the trust, to be nevertheless subject to the disposition of the Proprietors.
9. The Trustees shall have power to borrow money upon security of the property of the Club, or otherwise, and for such purposes to grant mortgages, effect capital redemption policies for the amount of any loan, and give any security that they may deem necessary. The orders, in writing, of the Proprietors, shall be obligatory upon, and a justification to, the Trustees as to any such purchase, sale, investment, borrowing, mortgage or disposal.
10. In the event of the Center ceasing to exist as such, from whatever

“CENTRO SOCIAL RECREATIVO”章程

1. Centro Social Recreativo，其俱乐部活动室位于上海麦特赫斯脱路115号，应根据以下章程运作。
2. 该中心应称为“Centro Social Recreative”，并应在上海葡萄牙总领事馆注册。
3. 该中心应为 proprietary club（私有会员制俱乐部），所有者姓名应在上海葡萄牙总领事馆以此身份注册。
4. 设立 Centro Social Recreativo 旨在为葡萄牙社区及所有其他社区的会员在上海提供一个中心且便捷的俱乐部，并进行所有者认为有助于促进葡萄牙人与其他国籍人士关系的一切事务。
5. 成立该中心的目的为：通过社交聚会、舞会、音乐会、牌类游戏、讲座、书籍和期刊来赞助娱乐活动。
6. 该中心应由一个管理委员会管理和指导，该委员会由中心所有者任命的五（5）名受托人组成。
7. 该委员会应包括一名主席、一名荣誉秘书、一名荣誉司库、一名助理荣誉秘书和一名助理荣誉司库，所有这些人均应为葡萄牙公民，并作为此类公民在葡萄牙总领事馆正式注册。
8. 受托人任职直至死亡或辞职，或直到所有者认为适当罢免其中一人或多人为止。新受托人的任命由所有者进行。所有证券收取、股票购买以及采购和投资均以 Centre Social Recreativo 的名义由受托人进行；作为信托标的之财产，仍须受所有者处置。
9. 受托人有权以俱乐部财产作抵押或以其他方式借款，并为此目的设立抵押贷款，为任何贷款金额办理资本赎回保单，并提供其认为必要的任何担保。所有者的书面命令对受托人在任何此类购买、出售、投资、借款、抵押或处置方面具有约束力，并构成其正当理由。
10. 倘若该中心因任何原因不再存在，从 whatever

11. All the concerns of the Center, including the purchase of furniture,
plate, linen, etc., and the acquisition of a proper collection of books

12. The Board shall have power to nominate Committees for any special

14. Membership in the Center shall be open to Ladies and Gentlemen of
the Portuguese and all other nationalities.
15. Membership will be divided into two classes; Ordinary Members and
Full Members; classification of each Member will be determined by the
Board.
16. Every candidate for admission to the Center shall be proposed by
one Portuguese Member and seconded by another and full particulars
regarding the name, address and nationality of the candidate shall be
entered in an application form provided by the Center.
17. The application of each candidate shall be considered by the Board
and shall be submitted to the Proprietors of the Center for their
approval.
18. There shall be no Entrance Fees. The Annual Subscription shall
be $12.00 for Ordinary Members and $24.00 for Full Members, payable in
advance. Subscriptions may be paid in instalments of $1.00 every
month for Ordinary Members and $2.00 every month for Full Members,
payable in advance.
19. The election of each new member shall be immediately notified to him
by the Board, who shall, at the same time, request him to remit the
amount of the Annual or Monthly subscription.
20. A newly-elected member is not entitled to participate in any of the
advantages or privileges of the Center until he has paid his first
monthly subscription; and as the payment of this Subscription will

15. 会员分为两类：普通会员（Ordinary Members）和正式会员（Full Members）；每位会员的分类由董事会决定。

23. 会员在缴纳当月会费之前，无权享受会员特权。如果会员在月底仍未缴纳会费，将被暂停会员特权。如果会员的会费在到期后两（2）个月内仍未缴纳，董事会将以欠款人身份将其开除出会。
24. 任何具有显赫公共地位的男女士绅，可由董事会选举为临时会员，任期六个月。必须由本会的一名葡萄牙籍会员以书面形式提议，该提议人必须基于个人了解证明其在政治和社会方面均适合被接纳。该提议还须由两名董事会成员签署。董事会可根据申请，按月延续其临时会员资格，期限最长为六个月。
25. 如果任何会员的行为，无论在会所内还是会所外，经董事会认为有损或可能有损于本会的声誉和利益，或者如果任何会员经董事会认定故意违反本会的规则和章程，董事会可要求其在规定的合理时间内作出解释，如果

after due consideration any explanation which he may have offered be

write to the Member recommending him to resign. If such Member does
not so resign within one month from the date of such recommendation,
the Board may forthwith expel him and erase his name from the list of
members, and such offending Member shall therefore cease for all purposes
to be a Member of the Center, and for ever afterwards be disqualified

offence of a member is sufficient to warrant his immediate expulsion,
they shall be empowered to expel him forthwith, and in either case
notice of the decision of the Board shall be forwarded to the offending
Member.
26. Any member may resign his membership by giving to the Board notice
in writing to that effect. Every such notice shall, unless a later
date is indicated, be deemed to take effect as at the end of the month,
provided his accounts are settled in full.
27. MEMBERS' OBLIGATIONS. All Members shall;-
(a) Carry out all the provisions of these Articles and the Center's
Internal Regulations and bye-laws.
(b) Abide by all the rulings of the Board.
(c) Conduct themselves at all times in such a manner as to be above
reproach.
(d) Settle immediately and in full all expenses incurred by them
within the premises of the Center, before leaving the house.
(e) Make good all breakages and damage to furniture, fixtures and
gear, except in case of unavoidable accident.
28. MEMBERS' PRIVILEGES. All members are entitled to:-
(a) Partake of all amusements and conveniences, subject to the
restrictions imposed by the Center's Internal Regulations.
(b) Introduce guests in accordance with Article 30.
Note:- Only Members of Portuguese nationality may propose and
second candidates for membership.

(a) 执行本章程及本会内部规章和附则的所有规定。

(a) 参与所有娱乐活动并使用便利设施，但须受本会内部规章所施加的限制。

A. The Club House is opened to members at 5.00 p.m. on week-days and at 2.00 p.m. on Saturdays and Sundays, and holidays. It is closed at 4.00 a.m. (except by permission of the Board on special occasions); after which hour all guests must vacate the premises and no members or guests will be admitted. Members remaining in the Club House must vacate the premises at 4.30 a.m. Any member remaining in the Club House after 4.30 a.m. shall pay a fine of $1.- and after 5.00 a.m. a further fine of $2.-.

C. Members are requested to place hats, coats, umbrellas and parcels of any kind in the Cloak Room, and are not allowed to place these articles on any piece of furniture in any room whatsoever.

6. DRAWING-ROOM
A. This room is opened at all Club hours.
B. This room may be used for the reception of guests.
C. Refreshments may be served in this room, with the exception of meals.
7. DINING ROOM & BAR.
A. These rooms may be used for the reception of guests.
B. A list of the ordinary charges in the dining-room and bar shall be kept for the reference of members.
C. A table may not be reserved for any member more than half an hour previous to the hour for which his dinner has been ordered, unless by special arrangement with the Board.
D. The right of any member to secure a particular table will depend on the priority of his order.
E. Dinners must be ordered before 8.30 p.m. and cannot be served after 9.00 p.m.
F. Suppers must be ordered before 11.30 p.m. and cannot be served after 1.00 a.m.
G. Wines, spirits, mineral waters and light meals may be served to members and their guests at all Club hours.
H. Servants are not allowed to leave the dining-room to apprise members that their dinners are ready, or to fetch for them books, newspapers, or other articles which they may want from other rooms.
I. Wines, spirits, liquors, mineral waters, and other articles of a portable nature are not allowed to be brought into the Club House.
J. Provisions other than those belonging to the Club are not allowed to be introduced.
K. All provisions, wines, spirits, and other articles may not be sent out of the house for the use of any member.
L. Should any objection be raised by members to the charges made, the matter must be referred to the Board, which may refund any amount paid which in its opinion, has not been properly chargeable. The servants have strict orders not to receive less than the amount claimed.

F. 宵夜必须在晚上11:30之前预订，且凌晨1:00之后不得供应。
G. 在俱乐部开放时间内，可随时向会员及其客人供应葡萄酒、烈酒、矿泉水和便餐。
H. 仆役不得离开餐厅去通知会员其晚餐已备好，也不得从其他房间为会员取来他们可能需要的书籍、报纸或其他物品。
I. 葡萄酒、烈酒、 liquor 、矿泉水及其他便于携带的物品，不得带入俱乐部会所。
J. 除属于俱乐部的食品外，不得引入其他食品。
K. 所有食品、葡萄酒、烈酒及其他物品，均不得送出会所供任何会员使用。

11. BILLIARD ROOM
A. Guests are permitted into this room but are not allowed to play.
B. The code of rules placed in this room is to be the sole guide if all differences that may arise.
C. Billiards take precedence of any other game.
D. A member having engaged a table, must, when his turn comes either play himself or forfeit his turn. He may not transfer his turn to another member.
E. A member may not retain the table when playing with the marker, if two other members desire to play; the marker, under such circumstances, not being allowed to continue the game. The marker cannot be called upon to play after midnight.
F. A member may not retain a table after playing one game of 100 up, two games of 50 up, or one frame of Snooker, or in any circumstances for more than forty minutes should the table be required by other members.

J. A new game shall not commence at or after 3.30 a.m., and all play shall cease at 4.00 a.m.
K. Refreshments, other than meals, may be served in this room.

G. 所有游戏按每分钟半分的价格收费。
H. 任何会员若划破台呢，须承担必要维修的全部费用。
I. 会员不得在台边库上放置台球设备以外的任何物品，也不得坐在球台上。
J. 凌晨3:30及之后不得开始新游戏，所有活动须在凌晨4:00停止。
